howItWorks.journeyTitle: From setup to daily attendance — it just clicks.
howItWorks.journeyLead: Choose a step to see how CheckStation helps your setup take shape.

steps.title: Create your workspace
steps.body: Register once and your CheckStation workspace is ready to shape around the way your organization runs.
steps.detail: One workspace gives your team a single place to set up, run, and review attendance.

steps.title: Add Members and staff
steps.body: Create reusable Member profiles and staff accounts for the people who help keep things moving.
steps.detail: Keep your people organized now, so every new check-in flow starts with a strong foundation.

steps.title: Build the right Group structure
steps.body: Use Standard Groups for simple everyday setups, or Structured Groups when you need classes, sections, or another layer inside the same workspace.
steps.detail: A school can organize by class. A workplace can organize by team. CheckStation keeps both clear in one workspace.

steps.navSub: Set the flow for each Group
steps.eyebrow: Set the flow for each Group
steps.title: Shape each check-in experience
steps.body: Choose the actions, identification method, rules, people, and email delivery settings that fit each Group.
steps.detail: A front desk can run differently from a classroom — all inside the same workspace.

steps.eyebrow: Match the look to your organization
steps.title: Make every kiosk your own
steps.body: Use CheckStation’s simple built-in kiosk editor to shape the colors, background, logo, cards, inputs, and layout around your organization.
steps.detail: A school, café, office, or club can each create a check-in experience that feels completely their own.

steps.title: Launch wherever it makes sense
steps.body: Run a kiosk on a shared tablet, use the browser with staff, or keep several Group experiences moving at once.
steps.detail: Every Group kiosk stays separate from the admin workspace and independent from the others.

steps.title: Review what happened
steps.body: Each check-in, check-out, and break becomes a record your team can revisit whenever they need it.
steps.detail: Filter activity by Group, person, action, or day and keep the full story close at hand.
